prompt: Objective: find why profit fell 20%. You've learned revenue is flat. The latest finding: COGS rose 25% while other costs held steady. What is the best next step?

options.text: Break COGS into its components to see which input drove the increase
options.feedback: Right. Follow the finding into the driver.

options.text: Look at revenue by product line
options.feedback: Revenue is already known to be flat.
Jumps to a solution before knowing the cause.

options.text: Ask about the client's marketing strategy
options.feedback: Off the objective at this point.

explanation: COGS explains the decline, so the next step is to find which part of COGS moved.
